title: Healed Since 2016 – Featured Healing Story
content: Healed Since 2016 – Featured Healing StoryRadical Remission ProjectMay 25, 20183 min readUpdated: Nov 9, 2023In 2015, Marcus was diagnosed with Stage IV lymphoma. Marcus started with chemo, but then decided to opt out and use only naturopathic treatments. Today, he has no evidence of disease. This is his story in his own words:I was taken to the hospital by neighbors – I was too weak to do anything by this point. I had lost 50 lbs in 6 weeks, and I was sweating through my bed linens multiple times a night. I couldn’t eat.I arrived at the hospital and was immediately informed that I had Stage IV lymphoma. I foolishly responded that I didn’t have cancer. Rather, I sold cancer policies. (My mind was not all there at that point). They disabused me of that notion. Immediately, I began the typical surgery, chemo, and drugs routine. The side effects were torturous on my body from head to toe. I was also hooked on morphine for the pain. Even the diagnostic tools that are used by conventional medicine I found to be outmoded, dangerous, and actually cancer-causing. Nine months later, I got the call that we all don’t want to get. “We didn’t get it all,” they said. More treatment?! I needed another route.In a huge library, one whole section was called, “Alternative Health.” That in itself is a false framing of the argument, since natural cures have been here for 1000’s of years. The American Medical Association is only about 150 years old. So, in my opinion, they are the true alternative. By now, my family had to move my bed to the library, since I now could no longer even climb stairs. Me! – a gymnast/cheerleader/marching band president/physical education leader?!If I could even get my head off the pillow, which was rare, I studied. One of the many books that ‘fell off the shelf’ was, “What in the Cell is Going On?,” by a nutritional biochemist. I loved it. I knew in my spirit the author was correct. I looked him up and went to Florida to find him. He was brilliant! After using state-of-the-art equipment 40 years ahead of conventional medicine tools, he gave me a new protocol. I returned to Tennessee and followed it perfectly. Six months later, when I returned to my oncologist, he found NO cancer! Importantly, no one in the oncology department asked me what I had done. I was stunned! That was a lightbulb moment (or firework moment!). The conventional folks weren’t curious. AHA! Cancer is a business, not a disease. Buyer beware!Regarding what might have caused my cancer…Although epidemiology of cancer is not oncology’s strong suit, I discovered that our cell phones [along with many other things] are irradiating us profusely. My cancer tumor appeared directly under my cell phone position on my hip…lymphoma on the spleen. Of course, our food sources have also been horrifically modified. All disease is cellular malfunction of one of these types: Compounding toxicities and/or compounding insufficiencies. It’s easy. We need to reverse our bodies’ courses of self-destruction. The wonderful, amazing bodies we all have are self-healing, and will work for us if we ‘feed’ this mechanical wonder the right things!UPDATE: As of October 2020, Marcus is thriving in health, post-diagnosis.Did you know you can stay up to date with The Radical Remission Project through their monthly newsletter? validation.statistical_improbability_notes: Stage IV lymphoma with reported complete remission after stopping conventional therapy and following an alternative protocol; however, no imaging/biopsy details are provided.
validation.extraction_notes: Cancer primary site details are ambiguous (mentions phone position on hip and “lymphoma on the spleen”). No specific chemo regimen, imaging, biopsy, or lab markers are described; remission verification is via oncologist statement only.

analysis.case_summary: In 2015, Marcus was diagnosed in hospital with Stage IV lymphoma and began conventional treatment (including chemotherapy and surgery) but stopped after severe side effects and being told residual disease remained. He then pursued naturopathic care and followed a protocol from a nutritional biochemist; six months later his oncologist reportedly found no cancer, and he remained thriving as of October 2020.
key_healing_factors: Stopped conventional treatment after poor tolerance and sought an alternative route
Extensive self-education and proactive health agency
Consulted a nutrition-focused practitioner and adhered strictly to a protocol
Strong internal conviction/intuition about the alternative approach
Support from neighbors and family during severe illness
unique_features: Patient explicitly frames oncology as non-curious and profit-driven, describing remission confirmation as a “lightbulb moment.”
Rapid severe pre-diagnosis symptoms (50 lb weight loss in 6 weeks; drenching night sweats).
Attribution of cause to cell phone radiation and food modification/toxicities.
analysis.analysis_notes: The narrative claims Stage IV lymphoma and subsequent NED, but lacks objective verification details (imaging types, biopsy, pathology, regimen, dates). Remission category best fits ‘inadequate_treatment’ because conventional treatment was started but discontinued and the subsequent remission is attributed to non-conventional protocol; delayed chemo effect cannot be ruled out from the narrative.
